one_line: A Pala-era Buddhist metalworker-monk crafting bronze icons that travel from Bihar and Bengal to Nepal and Tibet.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, slim but wiry build with craftsman’s forearms and calm, steady posture.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium-brown complexion, straight nose, soft but focused eyes with slightly thick brows, a few faint soot smudges at the temples, default expression a serene half-smile that turns sharp and concentrated when working.
appearance.hair: Black hair gathered into a short, tidy topknot high at the back of the head, sides and nape neatly trimmed; a simple narrow saffron headband tied once around the knot, knot-tail falling short at the back.
appearance.costume: He wears a wrapped monk’s lower garment like a dhoti in muted saffron cotton with a finely woven border in dull maroon, pleated neatly and tied at the waist, reaching just above the ankles; over his left shoulder is a dark maroon cotton uttariya (shawl) with a subtle woven diamond pattern and thin saffron edging, draped diagonally across the torso and back and covering the chest modestly; underneath, a plain, close-fitting, long-sleeved off-white cotton tunic keeps him fully covered; around his waist sits a narrow dark-brown leather tool belt with small metal loops and pouches; his feet wear simple dark-brown leather sandals with a central toe loop; on his wrists are two practical brass bangles and a single dark wooden mala bracelet, and he has small, modest brass stud earrings reflecting his metalworking craft.
appearance.signature: A medium-sized, partially finished bronze Bodhisattva statue held in his left arm, with clearly carved draped garments, a simple round halo, and an unfinished yali-makara arch behind it, while his right hand grips a long-handled iron chisel whose wooden handle is wrapped with dark cloth; at his belt hangs a small portable clay oil lamp with a soot-darkened rim.

ref_desc: A slim, medium-brown Pala-era artisan-monk with an oval face, black hair in a short topknot with a saffron headband, wearing saffron dhoti, maroon shawl, off-white tunic, leather belt and sandals, holding a bronze Bodhisattva statue and chisel in bronze-gold, maroon and saffron tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Pala-era Buddhist artisan-monk from Kurkihar: a slim, medium-brown man in his late 20s with an oval face, focused yet gentle eyes, and black hair pulled into a short, tidy topknot tied with a narrow saffron headband whose knot-tail falls at the back. He wears a muted saffron cotton dhoti, wrapped and pleated neatly to the ankles with a fine dull-maroon border, a dark maroon cotton uttariya shawl with subtle woven diamond patterns and thin saffron edging draped diagonally over his left shoulder to cover his chest modestly, and a plain, close-fitting, long-sleeved off-white cotton tunic beneath. Around his waist is a narrow dark-brown leather tool belt with small loops and pouches, and on his feet are simple dark-brown leather sandals with a central toe loop. His wrists bear two simple brass bangles and a dark wooden mala bracelet, and his ears have modest brass studs. In his left arm he cradles a medium-sized, partially finished bronze Bodhisattva statue with clearly carved draped garments, a simple round halo and an emerging yali-makara style arch, and in his right hand he grips a long-handled iron chisel with a dark cloth-wrapped wooden handle; at his belt hangs a small portable clay oil lamp darkened with soot. Emphasize the bronze greenish-gold of the statue, the maroon and saffron fabrics, and the serene but determined craftsman-monk energy in a consistent, redrawable design.
